subject: Interim continuity statement request for SOC 2 post-report window
messages:
From: Elena Soto <security@blueridgecap.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@blueridgecap.com
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: continuity statement for interim coverage (SOC 2 period gap)

Hi Kimberly,

We just received Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report that covers the period ending 2027-02-28. Our internal procurement and security teams require a short continuity/affirmation statement to cover the gap between that report end date and the date of contract execution so we can close the assessment checklist. Specifically, can you provide a signed letter (PDF) that: 
- Confirms there have been no material changes to Redwood's control environment since 2027-02-28 through the date of the letter, or
- If there were changes, briefly notes mitigations or where those changes are documented (control owners, tickets, or policy references).

Intended use: procurement risk file for Blue Ridge Capital. Target: we need the letter by end of next week (2027-07-16) to hit our Board review cycle. If you have a standard template, that will work.

Thank you — happy to jump on a quick call if it would speed things up.

Best,
Elena Soto
Senior Security Analyst
Blue Ridge Capital
security@blueridgecap.com

Attachment: (we received Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20270228.pdf in your vendor portal)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <security@blueridgecap.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: continuity statement for interim coverage (SOC 2 period gap)

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the timeline. Looping in Marissa (Security & Compliance) and Rishi (Head of Platform Ops) to prepare a short continuity statement.

Two quick clarifying questions so we can scope the wording correctly:
- Do you need the letter to be notarized or is a PDF signed by our CISO acceptable?
- Do you want us to state a specific coverage window (e.g., "through 2027-07-16") or simply "as of the date of this letter"?

Marissa/Rishi — can you draft a one-page statement that confirms control continuity since 2027-02-28, call out any material changes (if any), and attach our SOC 2 report? I've asked for the signed PDF if possible.

Kimberly Park
Director, Corporate Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: DRAFT: continuity statement for Blue Ridge Capital (SOC 2 post-report period)

Kim / Rishi — attached is a draft continuity statement (one page) and the signed SOC 2 PDF we previously uploaded to the portal. Key points in the draft: 
- Statement confirms no material control deviations discovered in the period 2027-02-28 through 2027-07-12 (we used today's date as the upper bound to be conservative),
- Notes two routine configuration changes (WAF tuning ticket #INFR-4219 and Vault rotation for non-production keys) with links to tickets, and summarizes compensating monitoring,
- Signed by our CISO (electronic signature).

Attachment: Redwood_BRIDGE_20270228_SOC2_Statement.pdf (DRAFT), SOC2_TypeII_20270228.pdf

If you prefer different wording (narrower window or explicit asset lists), say so; otherwise I recommend we send this as-is once Kimberly approves the ticket references.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: continuity statement for interim coverage (SOC 2 period gap)

Elena — thanks for the patience. Per your request, attached is Redwood's signed interim continuity statement that covers the period from 2027-02-28 (report end date) through 2027-07-12 (date of this letter). Summary: 
- We confirm there have been no material changes to Redwood's control environment that would adversely affect the SOC 2 controls described in the attached report.
- We disclosed routine operational items (WAF tuning — INFR-4219 and non-prod Vault key rotation) and the monitoring/mitigations in place (link to runbook and alerting dashboards).

Attached: Redwood_BRIDGE_20270228_SOC2_Statement.pdf (signed), SOC2_TypeII_20270228.pdf

Please let me know if you need a notarized copy or additional supporting evidence (audit logs, change tickets). If this satisfies your file, confirm and we'll mark the vendor assessment as complete on our side.

Best regards,

Kimberly Park
